name: r0-skinny16-cublas
author: solx-loop
description: For M <= 16 the GEMM is a 21 MB stream of B; 640 CTAs that load 32 KB each with 256-bit loads straight into mma.sync fragments (k permuted identically for A and B) beat cuBLAS's latency-limited small-tile kernels by ~10%. Every other M is served by cuBLAS (at::matmul_out) so the submission anchors Tb and Tsol per workload.
